guides.title: How Zuffi Business works
guides.summary: From the first message to money in the bank — in one picture.
steps: A client gets in touch
A WhatsApp message, a missed call, a portal enquiry or a walk-in. Zuffi saves them as a lead with their name, number and what they want.
Zuffi helps you answer fast
It writes a reply in the client's language using your business info. You approve it, or let Autopilot send it. If nobody answers in 5 minutes, Zuffi buzzes you.
Nobody is forgotten
Every lead gets a next follow-up date. “Who to call” on the Today page is your list for the day. The Lost money report finds people nobody followed up.
Deals and money
Move a lead to Won (or Visited / Delivered). Add the value — it counts towards “Zuffi helped you earn”. Record money in and out; profit is worked out for you.
Your team
Add staff or agents. Leads can be given to a person; you see who is late to reply. Salaries, hours and commission are paid from the Team page and added to Money.
Your data stays yours
Everything is saved on your own devices. Phone, Mac and Windows share it through end-to-end encrypted sync — the relay in between can't read it.

guides.title: Set up in 5 minutes
guides.summary: The first things to do, in order.
steps: Pick your country
Business → More → Country (on Mac: My business → Country). Zuffi switches on the right currency, payment apps, property portals and local rules.
Choose your business type
Estate agent, salon, clinic, shop, restaurant or trades. The stages, labels and money categories change to fit.
Write your business info
Prices, opening hours, location, how to book, what you sell. Write it like briefing a new receptionist. Zuffi only uses these facts — it never invents prices.
Connect WhatsApp
See the guide “Connect WhatsApp” for your device.
Link your phone and computer
Scan one QR code and the same business appears everywhere. See “Link your devices”.
Add your staff (optional)
Team → Add. Pick how each person is paid: monthly, hourly or commission.

guides.title: Connect WhatsApp
guides.summary: How Zuffi reads enquiries and replies on each device.
steps: Android phone (easiest)

Business → More → This phone: turn on the options you want. Allow “Notification access” for Zuffi when Android asks. Zuffi reads new WhatsApp messages as they arrive and can reply with the notification’s Reply button.
Mac

Install WhatsApp for Mac and link it to your phone (WhatsApp on the phone → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device). Keep it open. Allow Zuffi in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
iPhone
Apple doesn't let apps read WhatsApp. Use a “hub”: link WhatsApp to an office Mac, or to a cheap Android phone as a second device, and turn on Office hub mode there. Leads sync to your iPhone.
Windows
Windows shows the same leads through sync. Replies open WhatsApp Desktop with the message ready — press Enter to send.
Fully automatic (paid, official)
Bigger offices can use the WhatsApp Business Platform through a provider. Replies within 24 hours of the client's message are free; messages you start cost a few pence each.
Stay safe
Keep “approve before send” on until you trust the replies, and let Autopilot answer only people who messaged first. Zuffi never replies in group chats.

guides.title: Link your devices (QR code)
guides.summary: One business on your phone, tablet, Mac and Windows PC.
steps: On the first device, show a code
Mac: Business → Connect & devices → Link my phone. Phone or Windows: Business → More → Show a code.
On the other device, scan it
Business → More → Scan the code. Or copy the link and paste it into the box.
That's it
Add a lead or an expense on one device — it appears on the others within seconds. A device that was off catches up when it opens.
Keep the code private
Anyone who scans it can see your business data. If a phone is lost or a staff member leaves, make a new code (Security) — every old device is unlinked.

guides.title: Use a free AI model on your own computer
guides.summary: Private AI with no account and no monthly cost — runs on your Mac or PC.
steps: Why a local model?
Your messages never leave your computer, it works without internet once downloaded, and it costs nothing. It is a bit slower and less clever than the big cloud AIs.
Check your computer
8 GB of memory: use a small model (about 3 billion parameters). 16 GB or more: a 7–8 billion parameter model gives better replies, including Urdu.
Install Ollama
Go to ollama.com, download Ollama for Mac or Windows, install it and open it once. A small llama icon appears in your menu bar / system tray.
Download a model

Open Terminal (Mac) or PowerShell (Windows) and type:
ollama pull llama3.2:3b
For better quality on 16 GB: ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
Wait for the download to finish (2–5 GB).
Choose it in Zuffi
Mac: Zuffi Settings → AI → “Ollama — free, runs on your computer” → pick the model. Windows: Zuffi finds Ollama by itself and uses it when no cloud key is set.
On a phone
Settings → AI → “Download free AI” runs a small model inside the app (on recent phones, over Wi-Fi). For business replies on Android, a free cloud key (next guide) is faster.
Test it
Ask Zuffi “write a reply to Ali asking about 10 marla in DHA”. If it answers, the local model is working.

guides.title: Free cloud AI keys (Groq, Gemini)
guides.summary: Fast, smart replies — free tiers are enough for a small business.
steps: Groq (fastest)
Go to console.groq.com, sign in, open “API Keys”, create a key and copy it.
Google Gemini
Go to aistudio.google.com, sign in, click “Get API key”, create a key and copy it.
Paste it into Zuffi
Settings → AI → paste the key → Save. On Android, also open Business → More so WhatsApp replies can use it.
Keep keys secret
A key is like a password: never send it on WhatsApp or post it online. Zuffi keeps it on your device (in the Mac’s Keychain) and only sends it to that AI company.

guides.title: Speed alarm, lost money & chasers
guides.summary: The three features that pay for Zuffi.
steps: Speed-to-lead alarm
If a new enquiry waits 5 minutes, Zuffi buzzes you (phone, Windows island, Mac notch). At 15 minutes it buzzes again. Fast replies win deals.
Lost money report
Today shows people who asked and never got a follow-up. Tap “Follow them up” — each one gets a ready-written WhatsApp you can check before sending.
Money chasers
Money → Owed to you. When a payment is late, tap Chase: friendly first, then firm, then final. When they pay, tap Paid ✓ — it's added to Money in.
Invite back
Salons, garages and trades: Clients shows who is due to come back (e.g. every 5 weeks). One tap sends an invitation.

guides.title: What changes by country
guides.summary: Zuffi adapts to where you work.
steps: Everywhere
Currency, payment methods, where leads come from, reply language, speed alarm, lost money report, chasers and rebooking.
Pakistan, India, Gulf & other WhatsApp-first markets
WhatsApp group posts become stock and are matched to buyers. Tokens and installments with due dates. Urdu and Roman Urdu replies in Pakistan.
United Kingdom

Rental reminders for England: gas safety (yearly), electrical check (every 5 years), deposit protection (30 days), pet requests (28 days) and the earliest rent rise. Making Tax Digital quarterly export. Optional late-payment interest wording.
Not legal advice
Rules change. Zuffi reminds you; check GOV.UK or a professional before acting.

guides.title: Zuffi on your screen
guides.summary: The pet, the notch / island and the charging light.
steps: Pet
Zuffi walks along the bottom of the screen and brings your reminders. Android: Settings → Zuffi walks on your screen. Windows: tray menu. Mac: built in. iPhone/web: inside the app.
Notch / island
Alerts drop down from the top: the Mac notch, the Windows island, and a glass pill on Android.
Charging light
A light runs round the screen edge when you plug in, with the battery level.
Look
More → Zuffi’s look and colour: classic bunny or animated blob, and six colours. All your linked devices follow.

guides.title: Keep working while charging or with the lid closed
guides.summary: So replies and alerts keep happening.
steps: Mac

Business → Connect & devices → Keep Zuffi working. “While charging, don't sleep” keeps it running (the screen can turn off). “Lid closed” needs your Mac password; turn it off before putting a running Mac in a bag.
Windows
Tray menu or Settings → This computer: “Keep working while charging” and “with the lid closed” (only while plugged in).
Android
Business → More → This phone: “Keep working while charging”. Also tap “Let Zuffi run in the background” — phones like Xiaomi, Oppo, Infinix and Tecno stop apps otherwise.

guides.title: Security & privacy
guides.summary: What Zuffi protects, and what you can switch on.
steps: Your data stays on your devices
Leads, money and staff are saved on your phone and computer — not on Zuffi's servers. On Mac they are normal files in Documents → Zuffi.
Encrypted sync
Devices talk through an end-to-end encrypted channel (AES-256). The relay only carries scrambled bytes.
Lock Business
More → Security: set a PIN (phone / Windows) or Touch ID / password (Mac). It locks again after a few idle minutes.
Hide amounts
Privacy mode blurs money on screen — handy in front of clients or staff.
Lost phone or staff left?
Security → Make a new link code. Every device that had the old code is unlinked straight away.
AI keys
Stored only on your device and sent only to the AI company you chose.

guides.title: Something not working?
guides.summary: Quick fixes for the usual problems.
steps: WhatsApp messages don't become leads
Android: check Notification access for Zuffi is on, and WhatsApp notifications are not muted. Mac: WhatsApp for Mac must be open, and Zuffi allowed in Accessibility.
Alerts arrive late
Android: allow Zuffi to run in the background (battery settings). Mac: turn on “While charging, don't sleep”.
Other device doesn't update
Open Zuffi on it — it catches up. Still nothing? Business → More → Sync now. Both devices need internet.
Replies sound wrong
Improve your business info (prices, hours, area). Add today's update each morning. Keep “approve before send” on.
